newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases, follows quicker c.bank rate decline.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases, follows quicker c.bank rate decline.

text.p: The rouble edged down on Friday tracking the central bank's rates which had been easing a little
more rapidly since Wednesday, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jan 10 midday Jan 10 early Jan 9 close
"The dollar edged up and it is difficult to find another reason but the central bank's rate," one dealer said.
The rouble's official rate has eased 17 points since Wednesday, compared with the usual one to three points a day.

"The rouble has been devaluing a bit faster recently and it remains to be seen if this is a short-term trend or a sign that the central bank's rouble policy is changing," United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said.

In October the central bank said it would maintain its policy of a slow decline in the rouble for 1997. It has set a "sloping corridor" in which the rouble will depreciate gently from within a 5,500-6,100 range on January 1 to within a range of 5,750-6,350 on December 31.
